item.title: Android MediaStore: Why New Files Aren't Showing & How to Fix
item.description:
“Android MediaStore: Why New Files Aren’t Showing & How to Fix”

When you create new files on an Android device, such as images or videos, they might not immediately appear in your device’s gallery or file explorer. This is because the operating system’s MediaStore, which indexes and makes media files discoverable, hasn’t yet recognized their existence. Gallery apps and on-device browsers rely on this MediaStore index.

What’s the Root Cause of Undiscovered Files?

The core issue is a timing and indexing problem. After you programmatically write your data to disk, the MediaStore needs to be explicitly notified to scan for and index these new files. Without this notification, your newly created files remain invisible to the system’s media browsing capabilities.
